mapper.select: SELECT id, device_name, device_code, device_type, model, area_id, location, alarm_rule_id, status, create_time, update_time, file_id, ST_AsText(coordinate) AS coordinate FROM sys_device ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, device_name, device_code, device_type, model, area_id, location, alarm_rule_id, status, create_time, update_time, file_id, ST_AsText(coordinate) AS coordinate FROM sys_device WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, device_name, device_code, device_type, model, area_id, location, alarm_rule_id, status, create_time, update_time, file_id, ST_AsText(coordinate) AS coordinate FROM sys_device WHERE device_code = #{deviceCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_device (device_name, device_code, device_type, model, area_id, location, alarm_rule_id, status, coordinate, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deviceName}, #{deviceCode}, #{deviceType}, #{model}, #{areaId}, #{location}, #{alarmRuleId}, #{status}, ST_GeomFromText(#{coordinate, typeHandler=com.expressway.handler.PointTypeHandler}) NULL, NOW(), NOW())
